_comment: v3 rules v4 intentionally does not enforce, with the reason. src/parity.test.ts fails when a rule v3 enforced is neither enforced by v4 nor listed here.
radix: ESLint 10 and oxlint 1.49+ always require a radix, the opposite of v3's as-needed; not configured (src/oxlint/rules/core.ts)
react/jsx-no-bind: dropped by design decision 5: not in any recommended set, every hit was suppressed inline
react/prop-types: not implemented by oxlint; unreliable with TypeScript
react/jsx-uses-react: only existed to keep no-unused-vars quiet about jsx; oxlint handles jsx usage natively
react/jsx-uses-vars: only existed to keep no-unused-vars quiet about jsx; oxlint handles jsx usage natively
import/order: import declaration order is oxfmt's sortImports, on demand (spec 11.5)
@stylistic/jsx-props-no-multi-spaces: crashes under oxlint's plugin bridge on some jsx files; removed in stylistic v6
